verses.text: God said to Jacob, “Get up, head to Bethel, and settle there. Build an altar to the God who appeared to you when you ran from your brother Esau.” 🧭
Jacob told his household and everyone with him, “Put away the foreign gods among you. Purify yourselves and change your clothes.” 🧼
Let’s get moving to Bethel. I’ll build an altar there to God, who answered me when I was in trouble and stayed with me on my journey.” 🙏
They handed Jacob all the foreign gods and the earrings they had. He buried them under the oak near Shechem. 🌳
They set out, and God’s terror fell on the cities around them. No one chased Jacob’s sons. 🛡️
Jacob and everyone with him arrived at Luz—also called Bethel—in Canaan. 🧭
He built an altar there and named the place El Beth El, because God had revealed Himself to him there when he fled from his brother. 🙏
Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died and was buried below Bethel under an oak. They named it Allon Bacuth. 🕊️
God appeared to Jacob again after he returned from Paddan Aram and blessed him. ✨
God said, “Your name is Jacob, but it won’t be Jacob anymore. Your name will be Israel.” And He named him Israel. 📜
God said, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a whole company of nations will come from you, and kings will come from your own body. 👑
The land I gave Abraham and Isaac, I’ll give to you; and I’ll give it to your descendants after you.” 🌍
Then God went up from him at the place where He had spoken with him. 🌤️
Jacob set up a stone pillar where God had spoken to him. He poured a drink offering over it, then poured oil on it. 🪨
Jacob named the place where God had spoken to him Bethel. 📍
They traveled on from Bethel. They still had some distance to go before Ephrath when Rachel went into hard labor. ⏳
As she struggled through labor, the midwife told her, “Don’t be afraid—you’re having another son.” 👶
As Rachel was dying, she named her son Benoni. But his father named him Benjamin. 🕊️
Rachel died and was buried on the road to Ephrath, also called Bethlehem. 🪦
Jacob set up a pillar over her grave. That same pillar marks Rachel’s grave to this day. 🪨
Israel moved on and pitched his tent beyond the Tower of Eder. ⛺
While Israel lived there, Reuben went in to Bilhah, his father’s concubine. Israel heard about it. Jacob had twelve sons. ⚠️
Leah’s sons were Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn; Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun. 👨‍👦
Rachel’s sons were Joseph and Benjamin. 👨‍👦
The sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s servant, were Dan and Naphtali. 👨‍👦
The sons of Zilpah, Leah’s servant, were Gad and Asher. These were Jacob’s sons, born to him in Paddan Aram. 👨‍👦
Jacob came to his father Isaac at Mamre, at Kiriath Arba—also called Hebron—where Abraham and Isaac had lived as foreigners. 🏠
Isaac lived for 180 years. ⏳
Isaac breathed his last and died, old and full of years. He was gathered to his people. His sons Esau and Jacob buried him. 🕊️
